channel.title: EBK Deep Bag
channel.description: Sports research from Elite Ball Knowledge: real data, matched comparisons, and the myths that don't survive them.

item.title: Champagne, No Hangover
item.description: We followed every champion in four leagues into the season after the parade. They come back to earth. In the NBA and NHL, and probably the NFL, they don’t fall as far as anybody else that good.

item.title: The Fresh-Start Myth
item.description: We tracked two decades of NFL trades against players who stayed put. A change of scenery mostly isn't associated with a different player. What predicts the outcome is the job waiting on the other end.

item.title: Payback Is a Rounding Error
item.description: Every revenge game gets its own pregame segment. We scored 1,547 of them. The payback is about a third of a fantasy point, about the same as playing at home.

item.title: The Cliff
item.description: Running backs go over it at 29. Receivers and NBA players get a year or two more, hockey skaters three to five. We rebuilt the aging curves for 14 position groups in four leagues, correcting for every player who quietly washed out of the data.
